approval.scope: In-person educational foundation, simplified ten-encounter content, proposed five-meeting delivery structure, PowerPoint companion workflow, and UX requirements
decisions: Teacher-led in-person sessions with PowerPoint as the main presentation surface
Simple Arabic instructions with medical terminology and cases in English
Vocabulary and worked examples before guided and independent practice
One clear task per educational step
Ten retained clinical encounters organized in four Missions and five teaching meetings
Paper and discussion participation, optional learner devices and site login
One teacher session page for attendance, files, session completion and grading
Preserve prior assessment records under their original versions

cases.title: Exertional chest pressure
cases.stem: A 54-year-old man gets chest pressure when walking uphill. It settles within five minutes of rest. This pattern has been unchanged for two months.
cases.question: Which pattern is present?
cases.hint: ركز على شنو يثير العرض وشنو يخففه.
options: Pain only with a deep breath
cases.guided: The resting ECG is normal. Does this exclude stable angina? Yes / No.

cases.title: Dyspnea with congestion
cases.stem: A 63-year-old woman is short of breath when walking. She needs extra pillows to sleep and has swollen ankles.
cases.question: Which history question explores orthopnea?
cases.hint: اختار السؤال المرتبط بتغير Dyspnea عند الاستلقاء.
options: Is breathing worse when you lie flat?
Do you have pain after eating?
Does moving your arm cause pain?
cases.guided: New findings: raised JVP and bilateral basal crackles. Which working pattern fits better: congestion or isolated chest-wall pain?

cases.title: Fever and focal chest signs
cases.stem: A 22-year-old has fever and cough for three days. Examination finds crackles at the right lung base.
cases.question: Which working diagnosis best fits this pattern?
cases.hint: اجمع Acute fever وCough مع Findings بمكان محدد.
cases.guided: Which finding helps assess respiratory severity: oxygen saturation or the exact location of the cough?

cases.title: Episodic wheeze
cases.stem: A 20-year-old has episodes of wheeze after exercise and at night. She feels well between episodes. Examination today is normal.
cases.question: Does a normal examination today exclude asthma?
cases.guided: Which pattern supports a variable airway problem: repeated episodes with symptom-free intervals, or one continuous episode of focal chest pain?

cases.title: Dyspepsia and medicine exposure
cases.stem: A 28-year-old has epigastric discomfort. He takes ibuprofen on most days for back pain.
cases.question: Which medicine is most relevant to this assessment?
cases.hint: اختار الدواء المذكور الذي قد يرتبط بمشكلة Upper GI.
cases.guided: Does NSAID use alone prove a peptic ulcer? Yes / No.

cases.title: Pain moving to the right lower abdomen
cases.stem: A 19-year-old has abdominal pain. It began near the umbilicus and moved to the right lower abdomen. He feels nauseated.
cases.question: Which working diagnosis needs urgent assessment?
cases.guided: New finding: right lower quadrant tenderness. Does this strengthen or weaken the working hypothesis?

cases.title: Acute jaundice
cases.stem: A 23-year-old has nausea, dark urine and yellow eyes. The illness began a few days ago.
cases.question: Which symptom is described by yellow eyes?
cases.guided: In a symptomatic patient with suspected hepatitis A, which result supports acute HAV infection: IgM anti-HAV or a normal resting ECG?

cases.title: Fever with flank pain
cases.stem: A 26-year-old has dysuria, fever and pain in the right flank.
cases.question: Which working diagnosis best fits?
cases.hint: اجمع Urinary symptoms مع Fever وFlank pain.
cases.guided: The patient becomes confused and hypotensive. Should the team continue routine discussion or seek immediate hospital assessment?

cases.title: Thirst and frequent urination
cases.stem: A 21-year-old is very thirsty and urinates often. He has lost weight without trying.
cases.question: Which test most directly checks the suspected problem?
cases.guided: New symptoms: vomiting and deep breathing. Should this be a routine follow-up or an urgent assessment?

cases.title: Palpitations and heat intolerance
cases.stem: A 30-year-old has palpitations, heat intolerance and weight loss. TSH is low and FT4 is high.
cases.question: Which biochemical state is supported?
cases.hint: المطلوب تسمية Functional state؛ Etiology خطوة لاحقة.
cases.guided: What does a positive TRAb add in this context?
